title: custom:tile-group-card-pro
description: Several tiles on one card under a header (title, icon, badges): one under the other (list), vertical tiles side by side (row) or one line each (table). The group sets nothing on its tiles but their layout: each tile says everything about itself. Strings containing {{ }} are Jinja templates rendered by Home Assistant.

layout.description: list: the tiles one under the other; row: vertical tiles side by side, in columns alike, wrapping when narrow; table: one line each, the name, the value and one control or visual

vertical_align.description: Where the tiles sit in a card taller than they are (a fixed row count, a taller card beside it): at the top, the centre or the bottom, or stretched to share its height; the title stays on top

overflow.description: A row's tiles that do not fit on a line: wrap onto the next line, shrink on one line (names and values cut, controls that no longer fit left out), or scroll on one line. Row only

align.description: Where a row's tiles sit: stretch shares the width among them; the others keep each at the width the widest tile needs and put them at the start, the centre, the end, or spread out. Row only

columns.description: The most tiles on a line of a row; a narrower card wraps earlier. Row only, with overflow: wrap

padding.description: false: the tiles flush with the card and each other, square and without borders

title_tap_action.description: Action when the title or its icon is tapped, e.g. navigate to the room's dashboard (default: none)

badges.description: The header's badges, plain and small unless they say otherwise

tiles.description: The tiles: entity ids or tiles (the tile card's keys, without type, grid_options and vertical: the layout decides it; in a table without icon, secondary and badges)

visibility.description: Shows the tile only while the conditions hold
Shows the tile only while the conditions hold
